# 保存重载的原生事务快照；人物作用域为测试报告者，只读业务状态，不修复／重建事务。
# GUI在重载首帧、切换观察者前同步调用。记录精确恢复结果，防60日正常功绩变化混入保存断言。
# 输出h_china上的checked/valid测试变量；准备和清理均由原保存用例负责。
tca_test_merit_saveload_early_transaction_effect = {
    tca_test_validate_environment_effect = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_test_suite_aborted } NOT = { title:h_china = { has_variable = tca_msl_transaction_restore_checked } } }
        title:h_china = {
            set_variable = { name = tca_msl_transaction_restore_checked value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = tca_msl_transaction_restore_valid value = 0 }
        }
        tca_test_county_return_checkpoint_early_effect = yes
        if = { limit = {
            exists = title:h_china.var:tca_merit_saveload_transaction
            title:h_china.var:tca_merit_saveload_transaction = {
                is_alive = yes
                var:tca_mtx_phase = 1 var:tca_mtx_source = 1 var:tca_mtx_target = 2 var:tca_mtx_base = 1000
                var:tca_merit_saveload_transaction_sentinel = 12345 merit = 30000 merit_level = 1
                var:tca_merit_probe_approved = 1 top_liege = var:tca_mtx_liege
                var:tca_merit_reset_probe_gain_count = 0 var:tca_merit_reset_probe_loss_count = 0
                NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_merit_reset_probe_suppress }
            }
        }
            title:h_china = { set_variable = { name = tca_msl_transaction_restore_valid value = 1 } }
            debug_log = "TCA_MSL11 EARLY_SNAPSHOT_VALID"
        }
        else = { debug_log = "TCA_MSL11 EARLY_SNAPSHOT_INVALID" }
    }
}
